title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E01 — The Secret Space Program
On Dec. 20, 2019, Space Force is established, but in 2002, a man named Gary McKinnon claimed he had discovered evidence that a secret military space program already existed after hacking top-secret Pentagon and NASA computers.

description:

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E03 — Sica Sword
The smiths must forge a signature blade out of a 50-caliber flintlock pistol; despite giving it their best shot, it becomes a struggle to turn a gun into a blade and after two grueling rounds, two smiths get sent barreling towards elimination.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Chakram
The finalists go to their home forges to create an ancient Indian Chakram, and they return with two very different interpretations of that deadly, circular throwing weapon; only one stands up to the judges' dynamic battery of tests.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E07 — The Roman Gladius
After a hard round of tests that literally breaks a blade in two, the finalists get the chance to make one of the most important weapons from history, the Roman Gladius.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S04 E15 — The Gladiators' Scissor
With a variety of steels to choose from, the smiths are forced to create a canister Damascus billet from which they must forge a dagger; only two enter the final round where they must recreate an ancient Roman weapon known as the Scissor.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Khopesh
The bladesmiths are given a twisted challenge when they are asked to create a weapon from cable steel; after two rounds only two are left to return home and forge an Egyptian Khopesh.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E03 — Duel Swords
Three champions face off against each other, testing their signature blades and re-creating a weapon from the "Forged in Fire" vault until only one champion remains to face off against Ben Abbott, David Baker or J Neilson.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S04 E23 — Viking Edition
Competitors march into a dry moat where they resurrect old swords and forge them into a Viking Seax, using the time-tested coal forge; the finalists return home to recreate a pair of deadly Viking War Axes.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E07 — Trick Shot Showdown
The contestants face off at legendary trick shots including shooting backwards with a mirror, hammering nails into a board with bullets and throwing multiple targets in the air to shoot.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E08 — The Razor's Edge
Contestants compete with throwing knives and slingshots; in addition to the elimination challenge, another contestant suddenly goes home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E09 — The Shortest Fuse
The teams dissolve, as everyone competes for him or herself, and three people are ultimately sent home; In the first of two surprise challenges, everyone has to shoot a lit fuse sending the shortest fuse home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E10 — Season Finale
The final four contestants compete to determine the winner of the $100,000 prize.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E01 — Sharpshooter Surprise
16 competitors arrive from around the country and face a surprise right from Civil War history for an opportunity to choose teams; a team challenge of extreme billiards; an elimination challenge which sends the first two marksmen home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E02 — Shoot or Be Shot
Using prohibition era weapons, teams try to hit their targets, while being shot at with paintballs; two contestants face off with the iconic Tommy Gun.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E03 — Uphill Battle
The teams try to blow up an ammo dump, using the legendary M1A rifle; one contestant's mistakes put his team in jeopardy; marksmen face obscured targets challenge using the Glock 17 pistol.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E09 — Prohibition Pawn
A Civil War drum is brought into the shop; an 1834 book with the original rules of baseball; a customer brings in a 1970s skateboard.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E07 — Promissory Pawn
Corey and Chum look at a water-propelled jetpack; a promissory note from the Mexican-American War; a statue of the Hindu god Shiva is brought into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E02 — Ace in the Hole
The team is presented with an antique professional gambler's toolkit; Rick and Corey look to buy rare pieces of 1896 U.S. currency; a man hopes to sell his 1950s radiation detecting Geiger counter.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E21 — Darth Pawn
The Pawn Stars check out a 1763 Stradivarius violin; Rick and Chumlee meet a man selling life-sized Star Wars figures; Rick and the Old Man check out the World War II airplane's version of GPS, an octant.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S16 E01 — Pawn It Out of the Park
Rick heads east to test a rare 18th-century weapon; Corey takes a swing at a Mickey Mantle rookie card; military expert Alex brews something special for Rick's eyes only.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E15 — Catch-32
Mike and Frank have their work cut out for them on a huge property with more custom 1932 Fords than they have ever seen in one place; Danielle takes on an important military mission.

title: American Pickers
description:
S19 E20 — One Wheel Deal
In Missouri, the guys visit an historic homestead where they join the search for grandpa's lost Civil War uniform.

title: American Pickers
description:
Veteran Valor
A salute to the veterans as the most elite collections owned by vets of the greatest military in the world are shared.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E04 — Getting a Head
The guys are presented with a 1969 Buick Skylark; Chumlee and the Old Man look to buy a Civil War field desk complete with captured Confederate documents; Rick is presented with a human shrunken head.
